headline: Mexico defeat South Africa 2-0 in World Cup opener

article.body: Mexico opened their World Cup campaign with a 2-0 victory over South Africa after controlling possession throughout the match.

evidence.title: Official Match Report
evidence.detail: The listed fixture, teams, and 2-0 score match the official result archive.

evidence.title: Stadium Event Log
evidence.detail: Attendance and kickoff details align with the published match report.

solution.explanation: Official records confirm the score and match details.

evidence.detail: South Korea have one win, but goal difference leaves the group close.

evidence.detail: Only the first round of group matches has been completed.

solution.explanation: The win is real, but the headline overstates control of the group.
